title: Unique Domains MCP server: domain name data for AI assistants
description:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for the Unique Domains API. It lets an AI assistant read the record Unique Domains keeps: domain names, words, endings (TLDs), registrar prices, the domain market as totals, naming trends and the industry agenda.

Every tool reads stored data, and an answer carries its day where the record has one. None registers, buys or changes a name.

The server is hosted at https://mcp.unique.domains/mcp, with no sign-in. It also runs on your machine with npx -y @uniquedomains/mcp-server, on Node.js 20 or later. It is in the official MCP Registry as domains.unique/mcp-server. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api/mcp.
